text:
maria: Quick heads up — found a regression in runtime 2.14.3 affecting small-batch ONNX quantized models on Dedicated pools (reports from customer-replay tests).
jeff: Can you paste the failing log snippet?
maria: Sure, minimal repro from the replay job:
```
E runtime: kv cache mismatch for seq_len=1024
E model: quant_dequant error at matmul: shape (256,256) vs (257,256)
```
amanda: Ugh, that's the old padding/wrap bug we thought runtime fixed in 2.14.2. Do we know which kernel path this hits?
maria: Looks like it follows the onnx-quant fastpath, only when batch_size <= 4 and seq_len > 512. Happened in canary on dedicated/quantized-tag.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Detected new failure rate spike on dedicated/quantized-tag canary. 8 failures in last 10m (baseline 0.2%).
tonY: (cc @jeff) If this is small-batch only, we could pin 2.14.2 for pools with label "quantized" while we patch 2.14.3. Pin window suggested: 24h then re-evaluate. Thoughts?
jeff: Agree with targeted pin. We should avoid global pin — only affected pools. I'll draft the pinlist and PR to restrict to pools with tag=quantized & gpu_type!=a100_v4.
lin: Can we instead add a temp runtime feature-flag that disables the onnx fastpath? That would avoid messing with pinlists for customers. But risk is broader perf hit.
amanda: Feature-flag would require a rollout and smoke. Pinlist is faster.
kate: Also: update release notes and alert CS/Account for customers on those pools. I'll own comms.
jeff: Plan: 1) Pin runtime 2.14.2 to quantized pools (24h) 2) Patch runtime to handle padding in onnx quant path (owner: runtime team) 3) If patch ETA > 24h, extend pin and schedule controlled canary test. I will open PR for pinlist now.
maria: I'm going to collect failing traces and attach to the PR. Also adding one-off replay to verify after pin.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Pin request queued: runtime=2.14.2 target=label:quantized scope=dedicated reason="onnx-quant small-batch regression" requester=@jeff ticket=#INC-6421
jeff: Thx — please hold automatic unpin for 24h; manual review required before unpin.
tonY: Noted. If we need an emergency rollback later, deploy playbook step 3 (force rollback to X) is ready.
lin: For the patch, I can try a hotfix branch that re-applies the padding guard. ETA 6-12h. If it's ready faster we'll canary patch and then unpin.
amanda: Good. I'll update the release notes draft: add "Known issue: small-batch quantized models may fail on 2.14.3 — temporary pin applied to quantized Dedicated pools."
kate: I'll ping CS and the main account owners list once PR is merged.
jeff: Thanks team. After PR merges, I'll post final confirmation here and add the list of affected customer ids to the ticket.
maria: Confirming I'm attaching traces and a minimal repro snippet to INC-6421 now.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Pin applied to 3 pools (quant-prod-1, quant-prod-2, quant-canary). Action: manual review before unpin.
jeff: Confirmed. Closing loop for now, will update if plan changes. :white_check_mark:
